items.body: Best milk. Great fresh flavour well presented good price nice in my coffee and cereal

Good Milk. I really like that the milk is organic. Its 100% Australian milk. Not the biggest fan of milk cartons due to not being able to lock in the freshness but can appreciate that they are environmentally friendly.
Tasty milk. tasty and good price
Delicious Organic Milk! This milk was fantastic. I appreciate the organic milk at an affordable price. Also liked the carton rather than a plastic bottle. I have already purchased again.
Good flavour and quality. has good flavour and well priced
